briefTitle: Testing Osimertinib as a Treatment for Lung Cancers With an EGFR Exon 20 Change

typedChecks.sourceText: Age >= 18 years
Hemoglobin >= 9.0 g/L (within 4 weeks before registration)
Absolute neutrophil count >= 1,500/mcL (within 4 weeks before registration)
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Absolute neutrophil count >= 1,500/mcL (within 4 weeks before registration)

typedChecks.sourceText: Platelets >= 100,000/mcL (within 4 weeks before registration)

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have measurable disease; baseline measurements and ALL sites of disease must be obtained within 4 weeks to registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST/baseline measurements is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have not previously received therapies targeting PDL1, PD1 or CTLA4 within 6 months (180 days) prior to registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This rule specifies a 6-month washout window for multiple immunotherapy classes rather than a simple prior therapy exclusion list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Leukocytes/white blood cells >= 3,000/mcL (within 4 weeks before registration)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: White blood cell count is not among the allowed typed check kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants may not have clinically active or symptomatic interstitial lung disease or interstitial pneumonitis (i.e., affecting activities of daily living or requiring therapeutic intervention), or a history of clinically significant interstitial lung disease or radiation pneumonitis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Interstitial lung disease rules are subjective and involve clinical history/symptoms.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants may not have had radiation to the lung fields within four weeks (28 days) of starting treatment. For patients receiving palliative radiation to thoracic vertebrae, ribs or other sites where the radiation field includes the lungs, radiation must be completed at least two weeks before starting treatment. For all palliative radiation to all other sites, at least 7 days must have elapsed prior to starting treatment. At least six months (180 days) must have elapsed prior to starting treatment for radiation given with curative intent...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex site- and intent-dependent radiation washout rules cannot be captured in a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants may not have clinically symptomatic brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or spinal cord compression. Patients may be on a stable dose of corticosteroids to control brain metastases if they have been on a stable dose for two weeks (14 days) prior to study treatment and are clinically asymptomatic
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Wording allows stable treated brain metastases under specific corticosteroid conditions, which is not a clean allowedBrainMets status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have an ECHO or a nuclear study (MUGA or first pass) within 4 weeks (28 days) prior to registration to treatment and must not have a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < institutional lower limit of normal (LLN). If the LLN is not defined at a site, the LVEF must be >= 50% for the patient to be eligible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiac ejection fraction rule with conditional site lower limits is not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Mean resting corrected QT interval (QTc) >= 470 msec obtained from 3 electrocardiograms (ECGs) using the screening clinic ECG machine-derived QTc value...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Detailed QTc and cardiac ECG criteria are not among the allowed typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants may not have a second, clinically active, cancer. Patients with second cancers which have been treated with curative intent and/or are currently inactive are allowed
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Second primary cancer histories require clinical judgment and are not standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants may not be receiving any other investigational agents. Patients previously treated with investigational agents must complete a washout period of at least two weeks or five half-lives, whichever is longer, before starting treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout windows for prior investigational agents are complex and protocol-dependent.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants may not have uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, ongoing or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia, or psychiatric illness/social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General health status and intercurrent illness are subjective clinician judgments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have no history of hypersensitivity active or inactive excipients of osimertinib (AZD9291) or drugs with a similar chemical structure or class to osimertinib (AZD9291)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hypersensitivity to drug excipients or drug classes is a clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must not currently be receiving (or unable to stop use prior to receiving the first dose of study treatment) medications or herbal supplements known to be potent inducers of CYP3A4 (at least 3 week prior). All patients must try to avoid concomitant use of any medications, herbal supplements and/or ingestion of foods with known inducer effects on CYP3A4
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant medications and CYP3A4 inducer restriction rules are complex medication management criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (serum glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase [SGOT])/alanine aminotransferase (ALT) (serum glutamate pyruvate transaminase [SGPT]) =< 3 x institutional upper limit of normal; for patients with known hepatic metastases AST and/or ALT =< 5 x ULN (within 4 weeks before registration)
